title: Annoying Boss Punch Game
description: The ultimate office stress buster! Punch, kick, and throw eggs or water balloons at your annoying boss!
controls: Left Click to punch/combo. Arrow Keys to move.

title: Nitro Speed 2 Underground
description: Get ready for intense underground street racing! Drive fast cars and beat your rivals.
controls: Use Arrow Keys or WASD to drive. Press Space for Handbrake.

title: Archer: Dungeon Hero
description: Embark on an epic adventure as a master archer! Fight through dangerous dungeons.
controls: Use WASD or Arrow keys to move. Aim and shoot automatically.
